sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-07 and 2016-12-08, cardholder C02923 experienced unauthorized activity on card C02923-K1. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $100.07 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_new_device'. The primary flagged transaction 3523199 ($100.07) was initiated through the online channel. Activity originated from a device profile (iOS Device | iOS 9.3.5 | mobile safari 9.0 | 1024x768) marked as New for this account. The same device profile was also observed across 112 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C02923-K1 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.
